description.name: Ovajj
description.tagline: Accept invoice payments through Ovajj hosted checkout.
description.long: Ovajj Payment Gateway lets clients pay WHMCS invoices on the Ovajj hosted checkout page. Every payment is confirmed by a signed webhook and an independent server-to-server verification before the invoice is marked as paid. Supports sandbox and live environments and refunds.
features: Hosted checkout redirect (no card data touches your server)
Signed API requests and verified webhooks
Independent payment verification before an invoice is paid
Optional currency conversion to your wallet currency (live or fixed rate)
